checks.note: Both keep event_time and received/loaded_at and define day by event time
Both recompute a rolling 4-day window with merge on event_id, idempotent
Both give a freeze after ~4 days with provisional labels and tell finance
A has late-rate and revision monitoring but no DQ checks or reconciliation to source; B has checks, source row-count reconciliation and DAU spike checks
A states the DAU definition and uses event_id key; B gives grain and key but never states or asks the DAU definition, only the time zone
